rows.grounds: fused compound object; accusative neuter singular

items.question: Which alternative fractional or veda-based measures may be assigned to the central cavity?
premises: three six-sevenths parts may be assigned
arrangement is prescribed as an alternative
items.inference: the central cavity admits these alternative fractional measures
uncertainties: exact referent of vedāṃśa remains unclear
internal compound analysis of ṣaṭsaptāṃśatrayam is not fully resolved
items.plain_english: Or three six-sevenths parts, or then a veda-part, one should arrange.
